symbols.name: CircuitBreakingCacheStoreProviderBehavior
symbols.summary: Applies one process-local consecutive infrastructure-failure circuit to a complete named persistent provider.
symbols.remarks: The optional behavior uses the existing resilience pipeline's manual circuit control. A bounded counter supplies consecutive-failure semantics; recovery admits exactly one nonmutating quota/readiness probe. It never retries a mutation, consumes a source, or releases underlying I/O early. Registration omits disabled and in-memory chains.
